body:
The remaining KG-Microbe candidate disagreements include seven NCIT cases, three FoodOn materials and Acriflavine registry history. Review original CultureBotHT names, CAS, supplier/catalog details and current independent authority evidence before replacing the legacy CAS/local identities.

Scope: Anabasine Hydrochloride, Cotarnine Chloride, Pretomanid, Sutezolid, Bovine Serum Albumin, Sunflower Oil, Zymosan, Locust Bean Gum, Tara Gum, Sodium Adipate and Acriflavine. Lysozyme invalid-CAS containment remains under #753.

The original source identifies Sigma A7030 (BSA), Sigma G0753 (locust bean gum) and Biosynth YT58656 (tara gum). Preserve those product details in `supplied_form`, distinct from the generic ingredient identity. Preserve all seven BSA recipe memberships, including their original preparation qualifiers. The current PubChem structures match MIM's stereochemical InChIs for Anabasine Hydrochloride, Pretomanid and Sutezolid; align the less-specific SMILES with that reviewed identity.

FDA GSRS [Acriflavine 1T3A50395T](https://precision.fda.gov/ginas/app/api/v1/substances/1T3A50395T?view=full) records `65589-70-0` as PRIMARY and `8048-52-0` as SUPERSEDED and links NCIT:C76253. Preserve that source-qualified history separately from active CAS annotations; do not claim global withdrawal by CAS.

Acceptance:
- Archive original source rows, native ontology assertions, authority records and individual material/salt/structure decisions.
- Promote only reviewed identities; preserve CAS as verified annotations, supplier/preparation details, stable MIM subjects and recipes.
- Record the source changes through the mapping-change receipt chain and fresh complete-row/owner/evidence-bound reviews. No inherited approvals or changes to provisional roles.
- Verify actual KG-Microbe lookups, CAS node xrefs, absence of false equivalence, the full candidate and current graph coverage. Production promotion remains gated by KG-Microbe #1123.

Implementation continues in #754 and [KG-Microbe #1130](https://github.com/Knowledge-Graph-Hub/kg-microbe/pull/1130).

comments.body:
Implemented the eleven ontology promotions and the companion Lysozyme containment in [MIM PR #754](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/pull/754), commit `ef9a2d933faa682880fcdaddeb157b7753f747e3`, with runtime support in [KG-Microbe PR #1130](https://github.com/Knowledge-Graph-Hub/kg-microbe/pull/1130), commit `c4df95e3d17fcd36a27c59b67cf2b96c9467df89`.

The source review archives original names/CAS/supplier details, native ontology evidence, FDA registry statuses, PubChem structures and all seven BSA recipe occurrences. Eight NCIT identities (including Acriflavine) and three FoodOn identities are now primary; CAS is retained as a separately reviewed node annotation. Product and recipe preparations remain source-scoped. Acriflavine's old RN stays FDA-qualified history. Lysozyme remains local with no CAS under #753.

The full candidate verifies **1,696/1,696 MIM subject lookups**, with **zero unresolved name disagreements** and the one accepted Xanthine context distinction. All eleven current CAS annotations and the local Lysozyme hold pass actual runtime checks. Candidate SHA-256: `c4942b92a7e7af42cc63dbfa6f59f81eae192ef706f687c9613b113b23e9ad0e`.

The 22 additional retired CAS/local identifiers have no references in 31 existing producer tables (18,784,312 edge rows, including ignored files). Existing exposure remains 63 identifiers / 504 rows. Results, fingerprints and individual retirement dispositions are [committed with the KG-Microbe review](https://github.com/Knowledge-Graph-Hub/kg-microbe/tree/c4df95e3d17fcd36a27c59b67cf2b96c9467df89/mappings/reviews/ingredient-identities-20260924).

KG-Microbe full pytest and full tox pass (2,293 passed, 55 skipped). MIM schema/export/review/round-trip/static checks pass; final full-suite/CI status is recorded in the PR. The existing unified snapshot freshness gate remains open (130 changed records, budget 25). No production promotion or immutable release publication was performed.
